目前我国部分煤矿进入深部开采范围，煤矿冲击地压发生频率、强度及区域都在逐年增加，造成的人员伤亡与经济损失也日益严重。针对冲击地压预测和防治技术的基础，多年来各国学者从不同的角度对冲击地压理论进行了研究，其中最具代表性的理论有强度理论、能量理论、冲击倾向性理论和“三准则”理论[1-3]。随着现代数学理论的发展，非线性理论和分形理论也被应用到冲击地压机理的分析。有学者在总结试验结果和冲击现场特征的基础上，认为冲击地压发生的过程是煤岩地层受力的瞬间粘滑过程，并提出了“三因素”理论[4-6]。总的来说，我国冲击地压机理等相关理论的研究才刚起步[7-12]，解决实际问题还需要做大量的工作。因此，对于冲击地压发生机理仍需开展深入的研究工作。基于多年冲击地压理论研究和现场实践工作，笔者提出冲击地压应力控制理论，并采用相似模型试验和数值模拟研究，分析了原岩应力、构造应力、采动应力对冲击地压的诱发机制，尝试从应力控制的角度对冲击地压进行监测预报和有效防治，为冲击地压的理论研究、监测预报和防治解危提供新的方向。

sample.text: Abstract: To address the problems that geological analysis, overburden disturbance assessment, working face layout, mining succession, and economic evaluation are usually conducted separately in conventional mining district planning, and that overburden disturbance is often checked only after layout schemes have been generated, a collaborative regulation system for multi-scenario overburden disturbance assessment and mining district planning is developed. The system is designed based on the logic of “parameter import–core functional calculation–result output”, and integrates borehole and geological data management, geological parameter analysis, multi-scenario overburden disturbance assessment, mining district planning, mining succession, collaborative regulation, and economic analysis. First, a mining district data field and spatial layers are constructed using mining district boundaries, borehole coal thickness, engineering constraints, mining parameters, and overburden response results as inputs. Then, an overburden disturbance index (ODI) is established from displacement response, stress response, and fracture development response, and spatial disturbance distribution and zoning results are obtained. Finally, the ODI disturbance layer is coupled with the effective layout domain, coal thickness resource layer, and planning parameters to generate mining district planning schemes under different objective preferences, followed by mining succession and engineering economic analysis. The west wing mining district of the No. 1 Mindong Mine is used as the engineering case. The results show that, under the aquifer disturbance scenario, the mean ODI of the study area is 0.4669, the 90th percentile value (P90) is 0.7474, and the area with ODI greater than 0.70 accounts for 15.89%, indicating relatively high aquifer disturbance risks in local areas. The coverage ratios of the resource-recovery-prioritized, engineering-efficiency-prioritized, and low-disturbance-prioritized schemes are 98.52%, 89.34%, and 80.67%, respectively. The low-disturbance-prioritized scheme has a mean ODI of 0.4416 and a P90 value of 0.6353, indicating a relatively low disturbance level. The mining succession and economic analysis results show that the system can output succession plans, production sequences, risk months, and economic evaluation indicators. In the case scheme, the total mining period is 136 months, the target production capacity is 5.00 Mt/a, the payback period is 10 months, the unit cost is 324.7 yuan/t, and 40 high-risk months are identified. The results indicate that the system can incorporate overburden disturbance assessment into the mining district planning process in advance and realize integrated analysis of disturbance identification, scheme generation, succession checking, and economic evaluation, providing decision-making support for scheme comparison, aquifer protection, and collaborative decision-making under complex geological conditions.

采区规划是煤矿开采设计与生产接续中的关键环节，其结果直接影响工作面布置、煤柱留设、资源回收、巷道系统布置、采掘接续以及后续安全生产。传统采区规划通常以采区边界、煤层赋存、构造分布、煤柱参数、工作面宽度和推进长度等为主要依据，先确定工作面数量、位置及推进方向，对于断层、陷落柱、风化带、采空区等边界较为清晰的地质因素，设计阶段一般可通过避让、留设保护煤柱或调整工作面边界等方式处理；但对于采动引起的覆岩变形、应力重分布、裂隙扩展、含水层扰动以及接续组织和经济效益之间的关系，往往需要在方案形成后才能进一步校核和调整。因此，在厚煤层、软弱覆岩、强含水层或近距离煤层群等复杂条件下，在地质条件、覆岩扰动、工作面布置、采掘接续和经济评价之间缺乏统一的协同分析平台，不仅容易导致采区规划方案反复调整，还影响设计效率和工程实施稳定性。

outline.text: Abstract: To address the problems that geological analysis, overburden disturbance assessment, working face layout, mining succession, and economic evaluation are usually conducted separately in conventional mining district planning, and that overburden disturbance is often checked only after layout schemes have been generated, a collaborative regulation system for multi-scenario overburden disturbance assessment and mining district planning is developed. The system is designed based on the logic of “parameter import–core functional calculation–result output”, and integrates borehole and geological data management, geological parameter analysis, multi-scenario overburden disturbance assessment, mining district planning, mining succession, collaborative regulation, and economic analysis. First, a mining district data field and spatial layers are constructed using mining district boundaries, borehole coal thickness, engineering constraints, mining parameters, and overburden response results as inputs. Then, an overburden disturbance index (ODI) is established from displacement response, stress response, and fracture development response, and spatial disturbance distribution and zoning results are obtained. Finally, the ODI disturbance layer is coupled with the effective layout domain, coal thickness resource layer, and planning parameters to generate mining district planning schemes under different objective preferences, followed by mining succession and engineering economic analysis. The west wing mining district of the No. 1 Mindong Mine is used as the engineering case. The results show that, under the aquifer disturbance scenario, the mean ODI of the study area is 0.4669, the 90th percentile value (P90) is 0.7474, and the area with ODI greater than 0.70 accounts for 15.89%, indicating relatively high aquifer disturbance risks in local areas. The coverage ratios of the resource-recovery-prioritized, engineering-efficiency-prioritized, and low-disturbance-prioritized schemes are 98.52%, 89.34%, and 80.67%, respectively. The low-disturbance-prioritized scheme has a mean ODI of 0.4416 and a P90 value of 0.6353, indicating a relatively low disturbance level. The mining succession and economic analysis results show that the system can output succession plans, production sequences, risk months, and economic evaluation indicators. In the case scheme, the total mining period is 136 months, the target production capacity is 5.00 Mt/a, the payback period is 10 months, the unit cost is 324.7 yuan/t, and 40 high-risk months are identified. The results indicate that the system can incorporate overburden disturbance assessment into the mining district planning process in advance and realize integrated analysis of disturbance identification, scheme generation, succession checking, and economic evaluation, providing decision-making support for scheme comparison, aquifer protection, and collaborative decision-making under complex geological conditions.
